## Install

1. Download **Tidewall-*.dmg** below, open it and drag **Tidewall** to **Applications**.
2. The first time you open it, macOS may say it can't verify the developer (builds are not notarized unless the release says so). Open **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway** next to Tidewall. Alternatively run:

   ```sh
   xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Tidewall.app
   ```

Requires macOS 15 Sequoia or later, on Apple silicon or Intel. Checksums are in `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
